vector_memory.semantic_summary: EngineCache is a static service class acting as a centralized, global repository for managing and caching critical engine assets like 2D textures, cubemaps, mesh data, and shader source code. It abstracts asset loading, ensuring expensive I/O and parsing operations occur only once per unique key. It manages resource lifecycles via reference counting and provides specific retrieval methods for various asset types.
